create_metric_logger_from_string: create a MetricLogger from a CSV-formatted string with name, iteration, value rows
create_metric_logger_from_file: create a MetricLogger by loading metrics from a file on disk
add_metric_to_logger: add a named metric value at a given step iteration to the logger
save_metric_logger: save the MetricLogger contents to a file at the specified location
get_metric_data_by_name: get sorted metric data tuples for a specific metric name from the logger
